title: Customer Success Manager – Enterprise (m/w/d)
description: Als Customer Success Manager – Enterprise (m/w/d) übernimmst Du die eigenständige Verantwortung für ein Portfolio unserer Enterprise-Kunden und steuerst die gesamte Customer Journey – vom Vertragsabschluss über den erfolgreichen Programmstart bis hin zur langfristigen Entwicklung und Verlängerung der Kundenbeziehung. Das Ziel ist es, eine nachhaltige und strategische Partnerschaft mit unseren Kunden aufzubauen, den geschäftlichen Mehrwert unserer Trainingsprogramme messbar zu machen und langfristige Wachstumspotenziale zu identifizieren. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass unsere Programme erfolgreich umgesetzt werden und einen konkreten Beitrag zu den strategischen Unternehmenszielen unserer Kunden leisten. Es erfolgt eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Ansprechpartner:innen auf Kundenseite, insbesondere HR-Verantwortlichen, Führungskräften und Executive Sponsors, sowie unseren internen Teams, insbesondere Sales, Delivery, Fulfilment, Product und Support. Schwerpunkte Deiner Rolle Eigenständige Verantwortung für ein Portfolio von Enterprise-Kunden – vom Sales Handover über den Programmstart bis hin zur langfristigen Kundenentwicklung und Vertragsverlängerung. Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Beziehungen zu relevanten Stakeholdern auf unterschiedlichen Hierarchieebenen, insbesondere HR-Verantwortlichen, Führungskräften und Executive Sponsors. Entwicklung und Steuerung strategischer Account-Pläne und gemeinsamer 12-Monats-Roadmaps (Mutual Action Plans), inklusive klarer Ziele, Erfolgskennzahlen und Verantwortlichkeiten. Planung und Durchführung von Discovery Workshops, um die strategischen Herausforderungen, Geschäftsziele und Weiterbildungsbedarfe unserer Kunden zu verstehen. Verantwortung für einen erfolgreichen Programmstart und die Steuerung der ersten 90 Tage in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Fulfilment-Team. Durchführung regelmäßiger Executive Business Reviews (EBRs), um Fortschritte, Ergebnisse und den geschäftlichen Mehrwert unserer Programme gegenüber Entscheidungsträger:innen transparent zu machen. Analyse und Verknüpfung unserer Lerner- und Programmdaten mit den Business-KPIs unserer Kunden, um den ROI unserer Trainingsprogramme messbar zu machen und weitere Investitionen zu begründen. Identifikation von Potenzialen für Vertragsverlängerungen, Upselling und die Erweiterung bestehender Kundenbeziehungen sowie Entwicklung datenbasierter Business Cases. Proaktive Steuerung von Kundenbeziehungen und souveräner Umgang mit komplexen Stakeholder-Konstellationen sowie herausfordernden Kundensituationen. Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Customer-Success-Prozesse durch die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Playbooks, Templates und Best Practices. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit internen Abteilungen, insbesondere Delivery, Product und Support, um Kundenbedürfnisse zu adressieren, Herausforderungen zu lösen und die Customer Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Das bringst Du mit Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Customer Success, Account Management oder Consulting, idealerweise mit nachweislicher Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Enterprise-B2B-Kundenbeziehungen. Ausgeprägte Projektmanagementfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, interne Teams und unterschiedliche Stakeholder zu koordinieren, um komplexe Kundenprojekte erfolgreich umzusetzen. Strategisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, Kundenbedürfnisse zu erkennen, Geschäftsziele zu verstehen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen und langfristige Account-Strategien abzuleiten. Ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis und Erfahrung in der Analyse und Interpretation komplexer Daten, idealerweise mit dem Ziel, den geschäftlichen Mehrwert und ROI von Kundenprojekten nachzuweisen. Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis und ein gutes Gespür für Wachstumspotenziale innerhalb bestehender Kundenbeziehungen. Du kennst Kennzahlen wie Net Revenue Retention (NRR) und verstehst, wie sich Renewals, Upselling und Account Expansion erfolgreich vorantreiben lassen. Ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten sowie die Sicherheit, auf unterschiedlichen Hierarchieebenen bis hin zum Director- und Executive-Level souverän aufzutreten. Empathie, Verhandlungsgeschick und die Fähigkeit, auch schwierige Kundengespräche professionell, lösungsorientiert und datenbasiert zu führen. Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Salesforce, sowie ein ausgeprägtes Bewusstsein für Datenqualität und eine strukturierte Dokumentation. Hohe Eigenständigkeit, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und die Fähigkeit, auch in komplexen Situationen Prioritäten zu setzen und Entscheidungen zu treffen. Technisches Grundverständnis, Offenheit gegenüber neuen Technologien und Freude daran, Prozesse kontinuierlich zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Dein StackFuel-Setup Full Ownership: Wir stellen dich ein, weil wir an deine Ideen glauben. Präge unsere Abläufe ab dem ersten Tag und hinterlasse direkt echten Impact. Culture: Eine offene Feedbackkultur ist bei uns Standard. Genauso wie unsere zwei "Trustees": Vom Team gewählt, bieten sie dir bei jedem Anliegen 100 % vertraulichen Support. Hybrid Work: Für den optimalen Austausch arbeiten wir drei Tage im Office, an den anderen zwei Tagen entscheidest du, von wo aus du arbeitest. Workation: Bis zu 10 Tage Workation aus dem EU-Ausland, EWR oder der Türkei ein. Echte Community: Wir schätzen den persönlichen Austausch beim Kaffee, im Meeting oder auf unseren Teamevents. Belonio: Zusätzlich zum Gehalt erhältst Du monatlich 50 € netto auf eine virtuelle Kreditkarte. Level up your Skills: Stillstand gibt's bei uns nicht. Nutze unsere eigenen Online-Trainings, booste dein Wissen und entwickle dich mit uns zum Expert:in im Bereich Data & AI. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, geschlechtlicher Identität, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Alter oder Behinderung. Be part of a mission-driven health-tech company whose work directly improves people’s lives. Take end-to-end ownership of core operational processes that keep the company running. Play a key role in scaling Flinn , shaping how operations work as we grow. Work in a high-trust, low-ego environment with autonomy and clear ownership. Enjoy flexible working hours , remote flexibility, and regular team time in Vienna. Work in a net-zero company where all unavoidable CO₂ emissions are compensated with carefully selected, high-quality removal certificates. Du interessierst dich für Employer Branding und Recruiting-Marketing und möchtest dazu beitragen, GAMBIT im Talentmarkt noch sichtbarer und attraktiver zu machen. Du hast Lust, KI und neue Ansätze im Recruiting auszuprobieren und unsere Sourcing-Strategien dadurch aktiv weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und behältst auch mehrere Suchaufträge und Prozessschritte zuverlässig im Blick. Du hast Freude daran, Beziehungen aufzubauen, Talente zu begeistern und langfristig mit passenden Menschen in Kontakt zu bleiben. Du bringst Eigeninitiative, Neugier und Lust auf Gestaltung mit – besonders, wenn es darum geht, neue Recruiting-Ansätze auszuprobieren. Du arbeitest gerne im Team, denkst mit und gehst professionell mit sensiblen Informationen im Bewerbungsprozess um. Warum wir? Wir sind ein unabhängiges, inhabergeführtes Unternehmen mit 30 Jahren Wachstumsgeschichte und klarem Fokus auf moderne Technologien und smarte Lösungen – das macht deinen Arbeitsplatz langfristig sicher. Kernarbeitszeiten gibt es bei uns nicht. Du gestaltest deine Arbeitszeit eigenverantwortlich und stimmst sie mit Kunden- und Team-Terminen ab. Der Austausch mit den Führungskräften und der Geschäftsführung ist direkt, unkompliziert und wertschätzend. title: Business Process Domain Architect (m/w/d)
description: Deine Aufgaben Du übersetzt Strategie, Geschäftsmodell und operative Anforderungen unserer Kunden in eine integrierte Prozess- und Systemarchitektur. Du analysierst Prozesslandschaften, Steuerungslogiken und Abläufe und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Fachbereichen und IT belastbare End-to-End-Zielprozesse. Du identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und zeigst auf, wie Standardisierung, Automatisierung, SAP Business AI und neue SAP-Technologien Prozesse verbessern können. Du leitest aus dem Prozessdesign Anforderungen an SAP S/4HANA und weitere SAP-Lösungen ab und bewertest Lösungsoptionen hinsichtlich Nutzen, Komplexität, Integrationsfähigkeit und Zukunftssicherheit. Du gestaltest und steuerst zentrale Prozess- und Designentscheidungen und bringst kritische Fragestellungen gemeinsam mit Entscheider:innen beim Kunden bis zu einer tragfähigen Entscheidung. Du konzipierst und moderierst Strategie-, Prozessdesign- und Architekturworkshops und präsentierst Zielbilder, Lösungsalternativen und Empfehlungen gegenüber Fachbereichen, IT und Management. Du übernimmst die inhaltliche Steuerung von Optimierungsmaßnahmen und Transformationsprogrammen und begleitest die Umsetzung bis zur nachhaltigen Verankerung. Dein Profil Fachlich Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung mit Geschäftsprozessen in mindestens einer Domäne, zum Beispiel Einkauf, Logistik, Produktion, Vertrieb oder Finance, und kannst über deine eigene Domäne hinaus End-to-End denken. Du hast in SAP-Implementierungs- oder Transformationsprojekten gearbeitet und verstehst, wie Geschäftsprozesse durch SAP S/4HANA und weitere SAP-Lösungen unterstützt werden. Du kannst fachliche Anforderungen in Prozesskonzepte und Anforderungen an die Systemlandschaft übersetzen und unterschiedliche Lösungsoptionen fundiert vergleichen. Du bringst Erfahrung in der Konzeption von Zielprozessen, Prozessharmonisierung oder Template- und Rollout-Ansätzen mit. Kenntnisse in Business Process Management, Prozessmodellierung oder Process Mining, zum Beispiel mit BPMN 2.0, SAP Signavio oder SAP Cloud ALM, sind von Vorteil. Du interessierst dich für Automatisierung, SAP Business AI und neue SAP-Technologien und kannst ihren konkreten Nutzen für Geschäftsprozesse beurteilen. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Persönlich Du denkst strategisch und analytisch, erkennst Zusammenhänge schnell und kannst komplexe Sachverhalte auf das Wesentliche reduzieren. Du findest dich zügig in neuen Branchen und Unternehmen zurecht und verstehst deren Geschäftsmodell, Organisation und Prozesse. Du trittst gegenüber Kunden und Entscheider:innen sicher, verbindlich und überzeugend auf. Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen lösungsorientiert und führst Entscheidungen auch bei Zielkonflikten strukturiert herbei. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, teilst dein Wissen und hast Freude an der Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Teams. Warum wir? title: Clinical AI Research Lead
description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them. This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate. What you’ll do Research & Evidence Programme Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team. Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices. This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery. Cross-functional AI & Research Support Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc… What you'll need Clinical Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks Research Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar) Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies Leadership & Communication Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented How we show up Build for the next decade, not next quarter . Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism. Lead, don't wait . We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that. Follow the evidence . Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford. Own the outcome . Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander. Ship, measure, go again . A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless. Live in clinicians' reality . Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it. Why Heidi? You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver. Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally. We take care of you. We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office. raw.title: Clinical AI Research Lead
raw.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi is building AI that works at the frontier of clinical practice. As we pursue medical device registration and expand our clinical trial portfolio and product portfolio, we need someone who can hold the full arc from regulatory strategy to research protocol to working prototypes and translate across all of them.

This role is designed for a rare profile: clinically trained, technically capable, and research-rigorous. You will own the innovation pipeline from problem identification through validated prototype, coordinate the company's clinical research programme, and serve as the internal bridge between product, regulation, and evidence. You will operate as a senior individual contributor with a small specialist team and broad cross-functional mandate.

 

What you’ll do

Research & Evidence Programme

  • Lead and support clinical trials and pilots adjacent to product development and regulation from protocol through analysis and dissemination

  • Design evaluations with research/publication-grade rigour: statistical power, confounder control, reproducible methodology

  • Provide analytical support company-wide - elevating ad hoc analysis to defensible evidence

Regulatory & Compliance Intelligence

  • Translate evolving UK and international medical device regulation into actionable product and development constraints

  • Generate and maintain technical documentation, clinical evaluation reports, and post-market surveillance artefacts - directly analytically supporting the regulatory team.

  • Partner with compliance to ensure regulatory soundness is built in, not bolted on, a strategic moat, not a checklist

  • Serve as the accessible regulatory resource for product, engineering, models and commercial teams: making regulation legible, usable and deeply embedded into all engineering practices.

  • This role is strategic support, and ownership of all product and regulatory adjacent research activities with a strong supporting team to drive progress and delivery.

Cross-functional AI & Research Support

  • Act as a senior research partner to product squads, commercial teams, and leadership, providing evidence, framing decisions, and raising analytical standards

  • Supporting commercial requests with tender applications etc…

 

What you'll need

Clinical

  • Qualified clinician with active understanding of clinical workflow, risk, and patient safety

  • Experience in medical device or clinical AI evaluation, including familiarity with MHRA, UKCA, and/or EU MDR frameworks

Research

  • Postgraduate research training in a relevant field (clinical informatics, AI/ML, health data science, or similar)

  • Demonstrated ability to design, execute, and disseminate clinical or applied research independently

  • Fluency in quantitative methods: statistical modelling, NLP evaluation, speech analytics, and performance benchmarking

  • Skills in implementation science and translational projects involving new technologies

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong written communication, capable of producing high-quality documentation for clinical, regulatory, and commercial audiences

  • Collaborative operator in a fast-moving environment; able to work across seniority levels and functions

  • Experience managing small teams or contractors; structured, outcome-oriented

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting and organisational skills, with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders and for senior leadership

  • A pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that gives stakeholders a useful range of options and a clear recommendation

    • Investigate discrepancies caused by vendor configuration, attribution methodology, fraud or bugs in our own apps.

    • Participate in cross-functional discussions with product, compliance, finance, design, data and performance marketing, and prioritise requests openly.

title: Applied AI - Member of Technical Staff
description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role Applied AI Research at Callosum discovers the methods that make real AI workloads faster, cheaper and better, and turns them into systems that run in production. You will study how agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines and code intelligence stacks actually behave, then invent ways to optimise them at a systems level. A single optimisation can touch agent and workflow design, context and prompting, model choice, the serving stack and the silicon underneath. So we don't hire specialists in one layer. We hire researchers who can reason across the whole system, from agentic design down to the specifics of the model, and who have a feel for how inference and hardware shape what is possible. The role is research-led and engineering-heavy. You will need first-principles judgment to see what kind of system a problem needs, the rigour to prove that it works, and the engineering skill to build it yourself. You will sit across our research and platform functions. What you discover becomes product capability, and what you see in real workloads sets the research agenda. We run a flat Member of Technical Staff structure. Responsibility and scope grow with what you demonstrate, including leadership of the Applied AI Research function as the team scales. What You'll Work On Our research tries to construct optimal inference systems from the silicon layer all the way up to the harness: the system will learn from the actual deployment profile and tasks it is used on and optimise itself. Open problems you will own include: •⁠ ⁠ Reverse-engineering agentic systems. Infer the structure of agentic systems from minimal data, and find where it spends compute it doesn't need to. •⁠ ⁠ Routing. Build robust routers that send each request to the cheapest or fastest path that strictly matches or beats the incumbent model on quality. •⁠ ⁠ Proving there is no regression. Design layered proxy evaluations, that bound quality ever more tightly, from coarse checks down to a granular understanding of the system. •⁠ ⁠ New optimisation surface area. Extend the same automatic, detection to new optimisation techniques, and help decide which ones we pursue next. •⁠ ⁠ Research that ships. Run rigorous experiments, write up what you learn, and work with our platform team to turn what works into general product capability. •⁠ ⁠ Shared research infrastructure. Build the evaluation harnesses, benchmarks and experiment tooling the team runs on. How We Work •⁠ ⁠ Generalists by design. Our cadence is fast and our priorities move as we learn. You will move between projects as the problem demands, so breadth and the speed at which you learn matter more than depth in one niche. •⁠ ⁠ Research judged by production. A result counts when it holds on real workloads. Ideas move quickly from hypothesis to experiment to a deployed system. •⁠ ⁠ Close to real workloads. You work from real production systems and pipelines. Customer contact is scoped: team members who show an aptitude for it can take on more customer-facing technical work, but it is not the core of the role. •⁠ ⁠ A mix of experience. We hire across seniority levels. Experienced researchers bring proven practice from large-scale AI development, earlier-career members bring speed and fresh eyes, and each learns from the other. What You Bring •⁠ ⁠Broad, foundational knowledge across the modern AI stack: agent and workflow design, LLMs and how they work inside, and inference and serving. You can reason about how a change in one layer affects the others. •⁠ ⁠Exceptional technical depth, demonstrated through any of: research that shipped, production AI systems at scale, or an early or founding role where you owned the system end to end. •⁠ ⁠Rigour in experimental design, evaluation and benchmarking. You can tell a real improvement from noise, and you design the measurement before you trust the result. •⁠ ⁠A very fast learner who goes to first principles when the map runs out. •⁠ ⁠Strong engineering skills: you build the systems you research. •⁠ ⁠A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership. What Sets You Apart •⁠ ⁠An early or founding role at an AI-first, deep-tech company, where you made key technical decisions from first principles. •⁠ ⁠You have designed and built multi-agent or agentic systems from the ground up, and you also have depth lower in the stack. •⁠ ⁠Low-level systems or performance engineering: kernels, serving engines or latency-critical systems. •⁠ ⁠Experience of large-scale AI development at a frontier lab or big tech company, and the engineering practices that come with it. •⁠ ⁠Research in inference optimisation, model internals, evaluation, routing or distillation. •⁠ ⁠Publications, open-source work or public write-ups that show how you think. •⁠ ⁠Familiarity with novel accelerator platforms. •⁠ ⁠Experience working directly with external engineering teams. What We Offer •⁠ ⁠Competitive Salary, determined by skills and experience •⁠ ⁠Equity & Ownership •⁠ ⁠Private healthcare •⁠ ⁠We offer Visa sponsorship and relocation benefits to hire the best in the world •⁠ ⁠We work in person at our London office. You'll have the tools, space and setup to do your best work, and if you have specific needs, just tell us We're committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, and believe in equal opportunities for all. At Acturis, innovation isn’t just part of our culture - it’s in our DNA.

Our story began in 2000 in the garden shed of our co‑founder, Theo Duchen, who, alongside fellow former McKinsey partner David McDonald, set out to reinvent insurance technology. What started as a bold start‑up idea has grown into a global SaaS leader trusted by the industry.

 

Today, over 100,000 users across 40+ countries rely on the Acturis platform. By working closely with brokers, insurers, and MGAs, we continue to shape the market and drive new standards across both personal and commercial lines.

 

Acturis is proud to be recognised as a Great Place to Work® 2026 and to maintain a collaborative, innovative, start‑up‑style culture, even as we scale globally. With over 90% of our hires coming from graduate backgrounds, this is a place built for early‑career talent to thrive. And as an EcoVadis Committed‑rated organisation, we focus on creating long‑term value by operating in a sustainable and responsible way.

 

Day to day you will:

  • Work closely with insurers and brokers to help design and build insurance products within the Acturis platform, supporting the translation of business requirements into structured system solutions

  • Configure product logic including rating models, underwriting rules, data capture journeys and policy outputs, with training and support from experienced colleagues

  • Analyse and troubleshoot products, assisting with testing, optimisation and ongoing enhancements across the policy lifecycle

We offer mentorship from day one, a clear progression path, and real responsibility early on, because we’ve built an environment where graduates grow fast and make meaningful impact.

 

You can expect:

  • A transparent career structure, regular feedback, and 3 formal performance reviews annually

  • Opportunities to lead projects, manage resources, and mentor junior team members.

  • Intensive onboarding, industry-recognised training, and funded specialist courses as you progress.


You'll thrive here if you:

  • Have (or expect) a 2:1+ in a STEM degree and strong A‑levels (AAB minimum, including an A in Maths).

  • Are logical, analytical, organised, and quick to learn new concepts.

  • Communicate confidently and enjoy working in a collaborative team environment.

We have a variety of join dates available for this role, and can offer both ASAP start dates and start dates up the end of 2026

Ready to apply your technical mind to real‑world challenges?
Join Acturis and build a career where you’ll grow quickly, innovate boldly, and work alongside some of the brightest people in the industry.

Please note Acturis is an equal opportunities employer and positively encourages applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, transgender status, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity. For further information, visit www.acturis.com.

If you will require any reasonable adjustments to be made at any stage throughout the recruitment process then please email


Successful candidates will usually be contacted within 14 days of applying. Due to the high-volume of applications we receive, we are unfortunately unable to inform unsuccessful applicants.

Unfortunately, we are unable to offer sponsorship for this position at this time. Please keep an eye out on our Careers page for any updates regarding sponsorship.

title: Senior Advanced Support Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>NICE Public Safety – Senior Advanced Support Engineer</strong></p> <p>Location: Hedge End, Hampshire – Office Based(5 days in Southampton office)</p> <p><strong>Context and Purpose</strong></p> <p>Here at NICE <a href="https://www.nicepublicsafety.com/">Public Safety</a>, we develop state of the art solutions for the Public Safety market, bringing together voice, video and screen recording, playback and analysis for Security customers worldwide.</p> <p>We are currently expanding our Cloud Platform Engineering team to ensure we continue to offer exemplary service to our customers. As our products and support workloads scale, we are building an AI-first support model, and this role will help shape it.</p> <p><strong>Scope</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Advanced Support Engineer to work with an innovative product launching in an area new to cloud services.</p> <p>The primary focus will be providing expert insight and analysis of complex support and integration issues, escalated by our regional T2/3 support teams. The role is hands-on and requires you to resolve the support cases and tasks raised by our customers from production on our production applications. This role will be required to deliver scripts, tooling, automation, documentation, knowledge articles and guidance to the regional teams to reduce the ongoing effort required to support our products.</p> <p>This is an engineering-minded support role with an AI-first mindset. You will use AI tools and platforms, alongside your own technical judgement, to automate the triage, investigation and resolution of problems raised from the application, and you will help the wider support organisation adopt these ways of working as they evolve.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop subject matter expertise in our core technologies and services.</li> <li>Use tools to pull and effectively analyse logs, traces, and other telemetry to determine the root cause of issues.</li> <li>Provide root cause correction, not just symptom relief. Ensure that all facets of the problem are evaluated to eliminate recurrence of the issue.</li> <li>Design, build and maintain AI-first workflows (using approved AI tools and platforms) that automate the triage, classification, investigation and resolution of issues raised from the application.</li> <li>Apply AI to accelerate log, trace and telemetry analysis, and to draft root cause analyses, knowledge articles and customer updates, always validating AI output before it is acted on. Ensure that any data used is safe, secured and sanitised (removing personal, customer-identifiable and other sensitive information) before it is shared for AI analysis.</li> <li>Automate repetitive support activity through scripts, tooling and process automation, turning recurring issues into self-service or auto-remediating solutions.</li> <li>Identify, document, and report issues with software, design, reliability, and maintenance issues to the relevant teams, ensuring that they are aware of and are addressing customer expectations.</li> <li>Collaborate and help build utilities and tools for internal use that enable you and your fellow Engineers to operate safely at high speed / wide scale.</li> <li>Coach and enable regional T2/3 teams to adopt AI tooling and automation, sharing prompts, patterns and good practice.</li> <li>Measure the impact of automation and AI on time to detection, time to resolution and case volumes, and use the results to keep improving.</li> <li>Work effectively with staff in all areas of the business, escalating when appropriate to management and/or R&amp;D and Cloud Operations.</li> <li>Take ownership of, and resolve, the support cases and tasks raised by our customers from production on our production applications, through to a confirmed resolution. Proactively pull cases from the queue based upon your skills and abilities, and work cases that are increasingly challenging to develop and sharpen your skills.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Knowledge and experience we’re looking for</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in cloud support, ideally with a software engineering or developer background (for example, previously a software developer, DevOps or SRE engineer, a production or application support engineer who writes production-quality code, or similar experience supporting live production systems).</li> <li>Excellent technical and analytical skills.</li> <li>Experience and in-depth knowledge of data handling and MS SQL.</li> <li>Strong experience of programming or advanced scripting (C#, PowerShell, Python, etc.), including version control, code review and testing practices.</li> <li>Proven experience of automation, either through scripts and tooling or by automating and streamlining support processes (for example, CI/CD pipelines, scheduled jobs, runbook or workflow automation).</li> <li>Hands-on exposure to AI tools and platforms, ideally applied to automating triage, investigation and resolution of application problems (for example, prompt design, agents, tool or API integration, or retrieval over knowledge bases and logs).</li> <li>A strong AI mindset: you embrace AI-driven change, experiment with new tooling, and can critically assess AI output for accuracy, security and data-handling risk, with a clear understanding that data must be safe, secured and sanitised before it is shared for AI analysis.</li> <li>Experience querying API’s (REST, SOAP) and processing the output.</li> <li>Experience working on Production and Test customer systems.</li> <li>Exposure to SOA applications and services.</li> <li>Exposure to commercial cloud providers (Ideally Azure, others considered).</li> <li>Familiarity with observability and telemetry tooling for logs, traces and metrics (desirable).</li> <li>Efficient, effective and respectful communication skills both with customers and within internal departments. Including, <ul> <li>Good listener, able to identify and validate assumptions.</li> <li>Able to use effective questioning to confirm understanding of a customer problem and then provide help to solve it.</li> <li>Methodical troubleshooting, technical skill and attention to detail used in diagnosing problems and reproducing issues in a local environment.</li> <li>Multi-tasking and time-management to prioritise and switch between varied tasks.</li> <li>Curiosity and adaptability: willing to learn quickly, share knowledge, and change how the team works as AI capabilities evolve.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>You must:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Be flexible with working hours when needed to address critical or urgent matters.</li> <li>Will require to currently hold, or be eligible for, security clearance (NPVV3 and SC).</li> <li>Be willing to embrace AI and automation as a core part of how Advanced Support works, and to use approved AI tools responsibly in line with NICE security, privacy and customer data-handling requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who We Are</strong></p> <p>NICE Public Safety is a software solutions provider specialising in helping public safety agencies round the globe. Our NICE Investigate solution has recently become a significant player in the modernisation of the UK and US justice systems by facilitating digital evidence management and sharing in a cloud service.</p> <p><strong>What The Team Does</strong></p> <p>NICE Investigate is being adopted by an increasing number of public-safety organisations around the globe. As a result, we are expanding our Cloud Platform Engineering team to ensure we continue to offer exemplary service to our customers.</p> <p>Our Cloud Platform Engineering team is responsible for speeding up the time to detection and resolution of issues using tooling, telemetry, data and, increasingly, AI and automation.</p> <p><em>This job description is not intended to be all-inclusive, and you will also perform other reasonable related business duties as assigned by your immediate supervisor and other management as required. We may revise or change job duties as the need arises. This job description does not constitute a written or implied contract of employment.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Requisition ID: 12041</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Role Type: </strong>Individual Contributor</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: A platform you can believe in: Immersive One is the leading cyber resilience solution across the globe. If that excites you, read on! Immersive is the cyber proving ground for the AI enterprise. Through Immersive One, organizations can test whether people, AI-enabled workflows, cyber security teams, agents, and leaders can perform securely under realistic pressure, then turn that performance into evidence they can use to improve, benchmark, and report readiness. Trusted by 30%+ of the Fortune 100 and ranked #1 in the Forrester Wave™ 2026, Immersive helps organizations prove AI can be adopted safely, teams can develop and defend at AI speed, leaders can lead through crisis, and AI agents can be validated before they are trusted in live workflows https://www.immersivelabs.com/why-immersive-labs We help the world’s biggest brands like Citi, Pfizer, Humana, and HSBC, protect their revenues and brand reputations. Could you be our next AI Security Engineer? Due to customer demand and increasing maturity within our platform, we have an exciting and challenging opportunity for an experienced, innovative, data-driven Cyber Security Engineer with a background in implementing security in AI products to join our Container 7 team as a Lead AI Security Engineer. We’re looking for someone with a builder mindset who enjoys creating, improving, and scaling ways of working. You’ll have full ownership and accountability for your area, with real scope to shape the role and make it your own. You’ll thrive in a small team with a broad remit, where there is plenty of opportunity to learn, develop, and grow alongside the business. As a Lead AI Security Engineer, you will be a key player in our Container 7 team, shaping and influencing the rollout of our AI & Cyber security roadmap, simulating attack paths, demonstrating how to secure infrastructure and build security into your agents and AI landscape from day one - all while helping train our users to counter the latest threats. You will be constantly researching, learning, totally geeking out on all things AI security-related, from agentic security to the latest AI-driven attacks, and then taking that knowledge and creating labs and ranges for our customers. This role would suit someone who is immersed in the AI security field and has strong insight and opinions on how our product roadmap should evolve to ensure our customers have the tools to learn how to build and deploy AI securely You will design, build, and deliver practical and theoretical content to gamify AI security and make it engaging and fun for the end user. You'll shake up traditional training and teach complex concepts in an innovative way. If you have an extensive background in cyber security - in particular AppSec and cloud security - are experienced in the area of securing AI agents and securing AI-driven platforms, and want to disrupt how employees build their resilience against the latest threats, we will appreciate your input and give you the space to innovate within our market-leading platform, Immersive One, and our new AI Security product. Your main responsibilities: Utilising knowledge of offensive & defensive appsec and cloud security engagements to plan, write and deploy AI security labs, challenges and online learning content on the Immersive One platform. Lead on the building of content around security vulnerabilities in AI and Large Language Model (LLM) deployments (e.g., prompt injection, data poisoning, model evasion). This could be multi-format content utilising various teaching methods; practical exercises, questions & gamification Test AI Security labs and ranges to ensure they function as expected Research vulnerabilities, tools, and offensive tactics and compile this research to deliver practical and theory labs to users Compile technical research into understandable, concise content for both technical and non-technical audiences Work with the wider Product team on new projects and product innovations and how best to deploy them Sounds good? We’d love to hear from you if you have proven experience in the following areas (we know it’s tough, but please try to avoid the confidence gap. You don’t have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role): Proven and extensive experience in application security, product security, or cloud security, with a strong focus on AI/ML or LLM technologies. It would be highly desirable if you are experienced in threat modeling for LLM and agent systems, agent permission design, Guardrails and output validation, evaluation and regression testing, model drift detection, and Drift prevention Thought leader within AI Security - you’re someone who is constantly reading the latest whitepapers and thinking several sprints ahead as to what we should be building within our AI Security product roadmap. Excellent communication skills to partner and build relationships with engineering and product colleagues outside of the core security team. You’re a self-starter who is comfortable working with autonomy, takes initiative, and spots opportunities to add value. You bring a hands-on approach, with a willingness to get stuck in and support across a broad range of priorities when needed. Deep understanding of the AI threat landscape, including the OWASP Gen AI Security Project and MITRE ATLAS, as well as an understanding of adversarial machine learning techniques. You possess strong attention to detail, have a logical approach to problem-solving, and the ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment. Hold strong programming skills (e.g., Python) and familiarity with common AI/ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain). Immersive’s growth has been fuelled by our values that underpin everything we do, here's how they relate to this role: Driven - We push the boundaries of innovation, acting swiftly to achieve ambitious outcomes. Our drive embodies a culture of ambition, where challenges are stepping stones to excellence. Inclusive - Our strength lies in diversity, fostering a culture where every individual contributes to our collective strength. We champion open dialogue and empathy, ensuring a collaborative, inclusive workplace. Customer Centric - We seek to develop deep relationships with our customers to help them achieve their business outcomes. We exceed our customers and partners' expectations by crafting products, services and experiences that surprise, delight and ensure they feel valued and supported every day. One Team - We are a talented global team working together to achieve our vision. Central to our ethos, resilience means adapting and thriving in adversity. It guides our innovation, ensuring we and our clients are prepared for the future. We encourage people of all different backgrounds and identities to apply. We are committed to maintaining an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you and do your very best work. Excited by the above? We’re ready to receive your application! As well as an inclusive, supportive place for you to be you. We offer an extensive range of benefits so you can do your very best work: Time off, flexible and remote working so you can work when is best for you, includes 25 days annual leave + 2 volunteering days and your birthday off. The longer you are with Immersive, the more holiday days you get, up to a maximum of 30 days after five years of service. Look after your family and yourself with enhanced parental leave, mindfulness groups, critical illness cover, 7% matched pension, private healthcare plan and more. Career and learning development through the platform, a dedicated professional development fund and our ‘Learn Anything’ fund - which enables you to learn anything that’s not work! Recognition & Rewards for doing great work and living our values and behaviours. Informal or formal flexible working options, e.g. flexible start and finish times, reduced hours. We have a vibrant team culture with team events throughout the year. Our socials have included everything from pottery painting and paper mask making, to dungeons and dragons! When you do visit the UK hub, getting there is easy: we’re based in the centre of Bristol, just a 10 minute walk from the train station. The Supplier & Third Party Risk Manager will take end-to-end ownership of our third-party vendor ecosystem.   • Act as a commercial partner and advisor to department leaders across the business to support their purchasing needs, helping them navigate onboarding smoothly.

People Operations Coordinator

About Runa:

Runa is pioneering a first-of-its-kind payment rail that enables the seamless, global money movement at scale. Legacy banking and payment infrastructure struggles to support the demands of today's low-volume, high-velocity payouts, leading to inefficiencies in global payouts. Businesses worldwide send over $20 trillion annually in rewards, remittances, and disbursements often incurring costs of up to 50% per transaction and subjecting recipients to lengthy delays.

Runa transforms this landscape by providing a new digital payments infrastructure that empowers businesses to send digital money instantly and cost-free to anyone, anywhere. The Runa API empowers thousands of businesses to make payments to 5 billion+ consumers in 190+ countries instantly to cards, wallets, bank accounts and gift cards. Leading companies such as Sodexo, TopCashback, Perkbox, Sweatcoin, Coinbase, and Globetopper rely on Runa to facilitate instant, flexible global payouts to tens of millions of consumers.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a People Operations Coordinator to join the Runa, People & Talent team and play a key role in delivering an exceptional employee experience. In this position, you’ll own vital HR processes, including onboarding and offboarding, HiBob and employee data, payroll and benefits changes and compliance, ensuring our people feel supported and engaged.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with some HR experience who is ready to take on more ownership in a dynamic, fast-paced setting. Working directly with our People & Talent Lead, you’ll be exposed to the full employee lifecycle, build your skills across HR operations and compliance and help shape how our People processes scale as Runa grows.

What Excites You

  • Being the reliable go-to person for employees across the business and helping them have a positive workplace experience.

  • Owning onboarding and offboarding, ensuring smooth transitions for everyone joining and leaving Runa.

  • Keeping HiBob and our People data accurate, and bringing it to life through reporting that supports key People decisions.

  • Being hands-on with a wide variety of HR tasks and projects, from payroll and benefits to compliance and company events and seeing your work make a direct impact on employee satisfaction.

What Excites Us

raw.title: Manufacturing Security Lead
raw.description:
We’re a team of experts pushing the limits of what’s possible, united by our common goal to unlock true freedom through digital ownership, making technology accessible for all. We believe in a world where users, creators and enterprises manage their value with ownership and freedom. Our curiosity drives us to innovate, empowering individuals on a global scale. We believe change is constant and our team moves forward as one, with a culture of problem-solving where every employee is empowered and supported to challenge tradition and create solutions. Our mission is simple: to make self-custody accessible and give people the keys to their own financial futures. If you want to make a true impact, we want you to join us at Ledger.

At Ledger, we’re proud to be the global platform for digital assets and Web3, with over 20% of the world’s crypto assets secured through our Ledger devices. With our headquarters in Paris, and offices in Vierzon, Grenoble, Montpellier, London, Portland, Geneva, Zurich and Central Singapore, we have a team of around 600 professionals developing a variety of products and services to enable individuals and companies to securely buy, store, swap, grow and manage crypto assets – including the Ledger hardware wallets line with more than 7.5 millions units already sold in 200 countries.

 

The team:

Directly reporting to the Head of Physical Security, you'll own the security of Ledger's hardware manufacturing and supply chain, from components to finished devices, working with Operations, our contract manufacturers and specialist product-security teams

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Define and maintain security requirements for manufacturing lines, suppliers and production changes.

  • Protect the exchange and integrity of sensitive manufacturing documentation, firmware and production artifacts, with strong supplier identity and authorisation.

  • Run component provenance checks, lot sampling and inspection, and the security gates of each production run.

  • Plan and run supplier and manufacturing-site assessments together with Physical Security.

  • Coordinate hardware tampering and supply-chain attack tests with Ledger's Donjon team and offensive-security specialists.

  • Set indicators and escalation thresholds, and coordinate investigations when something looks wrong.

  • Report progress and remaining exposure to security leadership.

  • Build and lead the manufacturing security team, and own its strategy, roadmap and budget.

  • Represent manufacturing security to Ledger's executives and to the leadership of our contract manufacturers and key suppliers.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • 10+ years in hardware, electronics or manufacturing security, including 5+ years leading a function or a supplier security programme.

  • Director-level management experience: you have built and led a security team, owned its budget and supplier relationships, and reported to executives.

  • Experience with hardware products built by contract manufacturers.

  • You have found or prevented a real tampering, counterfeit or manufacturing-integrity case.

  • You have run supplier and manufacturing-site assessments and worked directly with engineering and production teams.

  • Knowledge of supply-chain security frameworks such as NIST SP 800-161 and ISO 28000.

  • Fluent English.

 

At Ledger, we are dedicated to continually investing in our employees which is why we offer more than just salaries; we provide comprehensive compensation packages that include a wide range of benefits. Here are some of the benefits you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work options - Our hybrid policy allows employees to work from home up to 3 times per week

  • Health & Wellness support - Health and Life Insurance.

  • Financial growth opportunities - Employees can become shareholders in Ledger as well as other financial benefits depending on your country of work.

  • Commuter allowance - Ledger offers a commuter allowance to contribute to your preferred means of transportation.

  • Learning & Development - A comprehensive suite of training solutions providing a personalised learning experience for every employee.

description: 🚲 Derrière chaque piste cyclable pérennisée, chaque site naturel préservé, il y a une décision. Et derrière cette décision, il y a nos données. Nos capteurs connectés mesurent la fréquentation piétons et cyclistes, en ville comme en pleine nature, et nos logiciels transforment ces données en indicateurs concrets : impact d’un aménagement, évolution de la pratique, effet des saisons. Parce que compter, c’est bien, mais donner du sens aux chiffres, c’est encore mieux ! 🌍 Pionniers et leader mondial d’un métier que nous avons créé il y a plus de 20 ans, nous sommes basés en Bretagne, avec des filiales sur quatre continents et des solutions présentes dans plus de 55 pays. 🤝 Une entreprise à taille humaine, portée par l’autonomie, la responsabilité et la transparence, avec beaucoup de passion (et de plaisir !). Envie que vos compétences aient un impact concret ? Nous recherchons notre prochain·e : Stage de fin d’études · 6 mois · Lannion (22) Nous préparons un nouveau banc de test capable de piloter une dizaine de produits différents. Chaque produit sera relié à une carte de pilotage qui gère ses interfaces, son alimentation et la mesure de sa consommation. Un poste central dialogue ensuite avec chacune de ces cartes pour dérouler les tests et scénarios attendus. Le défi : router les bons bus vers le bon produit selon le test en cours (USB, UART, I2C, JTAG, …), et pouvoir déconnecter physiquement les équipements pour mesurer la consommation sans perturbation. Les loisirs, nautiques notamment, sont particulièrement accessibles par la localisation à 5 km de la Côte de Granit Rose Ce que l’on te met à disposition : Des outils performants qui permettront d’exprimer pleinement tes talents Une équipe de passionnés qui travaillera à tes côtés 👉 Et si c’était toi ? – Bac+5, école d’ingénieur ou master en électronique / systèmes embarqués – Électronique numérique : bus UART, I2C, JTAG, conception de cartes – Firmware embarqué en C sur microcontrôleur – Bases en mesure de courant, alimentation et asservissement – Python pour la supervision et l’automatisation des tests, Git, CI/CD (Jenkins ) – Curieux(se), autonome, rigoureux(se), à l’aise en laboratoire L’entreprise et le projet te plaisent ? « il ne faut jamais remettre au lendemain ce qu'on peut faire le jour-même » : Tu n’es pas arrivé.e jusqu’ici pour postuler « plus tard » ! C’est rapide, ça prend 2 minutes (et c’est vrai !) ❓ Et après ? title: Senior Key Account Executive
description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense . Tu seras amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale. Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…). Pour accompagner notre croissance, nous renforçons l'équipe Sales de Vertical Expense . Tu y prendras en charge le développement de grands comptes publics et privés, sur des ventes complexes à forts enjeux. Tu auras pour mission de : Piloter le cycle de vente de bout en bout : qualification des opportunités, proposition de valeur différenciante, accès aux décideurs, négociation et closing. Développer de nouvelles opportunités par une prospection ciblée, en complément des leads apportés par le Marketing et par nos équipes Alliances & Channel. Analyser les besoins de tes prospects et présenter la solution, avec l'appui de l'avant-vente sur les projets complexes. Rédiger les réponses aux appels d'offres publics et privés (dont le mémoire technique), en t'appuyant sur les équipes internes. Assurer une passation fluide vers les équipes projets et CSM, et suivre les projets en appui après la signature. Participer aux réflexions stratégiques : veille concurrentielle, tendances du marché, différenciateurs produit. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as une expérience significative et récente en vente complexe SaaS B2B auprès de grands comptes. Tu as déjà mené des cycles de vente longs, dans des organisations multi-décideurs, en travaillant avec des partenaires et des influenceurs. Tu as un vrai goût pour la chasse : aller chercher de nouveaux clients te motive. Tu es à l'aise face à des interlocuteurs C-level et tu sais adapter ton discours à chacun (idéalement DAF, DRH, Travel Manager, DSI…). Tu sais répondre à un appel d'offres avec rigueur, de la réponse au mémoire technique. Tu comprends les solutions SaaS, web et mobiles. Tu es autonome, organisé(e) et tenace, et tu sais rebondir face à un deal perdu. Tu aimes travailler en équipe avec le Marketing, l’équipe Alliance/Channel, les équipes projets et le Produit. Tu es à l'aise avec des déplacements réguliers chez les clients (environ une fois par semaine). C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers des notes de frais ou du voyage d'affaires. Tu parles anglais. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un poste stratégique, au cœur de notre développement sur les grands comptes publics et privés. Pas que de la prospection à froid : une partie des leads vient du Marketing et de nos partenaires. Une vision complète du cycle de vente, jusqu'au suivi du projet client. Une équipe stable, fière de ses grands comptes, avec le sens du service et de l'excellence. Une ambiance où l'on ne se prend pas au sérieux : team building réguliers… Processus de recrutement : Entretien téléphonique RH. Entretien avec le manager. Mise en situation : étude de cas sur un compte client fictif. Entretien final avec la Direction. Localisation : Montagnat (01), avec 2 jours par semaine sur site et des déplacements ponctuels à Aix-en-Provence. Rémunération : fixe : 60K € - 80K€ + variable Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Head of Sales Enablement & Excellence
description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d'utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s'impose comme une référence sur le marché français. N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100 % connectée (app web et mobile). Portés par une équipe engagée de 230 collaborateurs, qui place l'humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Être Head of Sales Excellence & Enablement chez N2JSoft : Ta mission est de faire monter en compétence l'ensemble de l'organisation commerciale (une quarantaine de personnes : SDR, AEs, AMs, growth) et structurer notre façon de vendre , en France, en DACH et en Italie. De nombreux sujets restent à formaliser : tu poses le cadre et tu le fais vivre au quotidien, au croisement du Sales , du Marketing et du Produit . Tes principales missions : Structuration du process commercial Formaliser le process de vente : étapes du cycle, rôles et responsabilités de chaque fonction (SDR, commerciaux, managers). Définir, avec les managers commerciaux, les critères de qualification des opportunités et garantir leur application. Analyser le cycle de vente afin d'identifier les points de friction et proposer des axes d'amélioration, en collaboration avec le RevOps. Onboarding et formation Concevoir et piloter le parcours d'intégration des SDR et des commerciaux, en français et en anglais. Construire et faire évoluer le programme de formation continue (produit, concurrence, techniques de vente), en mobilisant les experts internes. Concevoir, en lien avec le Product Marketing, les supports commerciaux (pitch, battlecards) et en assurer la mise à jour. Coaching et performance commerciale Mettre en place un coaching individuel et collectif fondé sur l'analyse des appels et des démos, notamment à l'aide d'outils d'IA. Assurer l'alignement des équipes sur les messages et les process, en étroite collaboration avec les managers commerciaux. Garantir l'adoption des outils commerciaux (Pipedrive notamment) et évaluer les solutions d'IA pertinentes. Définir et suivre les indicateurs de performance : délai de montée en compétence des nouvelles recrues, taux de conversion, utilisation des supports. Profil recherché : Tu as déjà occupé un poste de Sales Enablement, ou un rôle proche (Sales Ops, RevOps, Product Marketing, commercial devenu formateur) dans un environnement SaaS / logiciel B2B ou dans le conseil. Tu maîtrises parfaitement les fondamentaux de la vente B2B et les cycles de vente SaaS, et tu as déjà déployé une méthodologie de qualification (SPICED, MEDDIC…). Tu es exigeant(e) : une fois les règles définies, tu veilles à ce qu'elles soient appliquées. Tu as un goût prononcé pour l'animation et la pédagogie, et une réelle aisance à l'oral face à des équipes commerciales. Tu sais structurer un sujet de manière autonome, sans cadre préexistant. Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et souhaites en faire un levier de performance pour les équipes commerciales. Tu maîtrises l'anglais, indispensable pour communiquer avec nos équipes internationales. C'est un plus si : Tu connais l'univers du spend management. Tu as évolué dans un environnement en forte croissance Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un rôle stratégique, avec un impact direct et mesurable sur notre croissance. Un poste à construire : process, méthodologie, formations, outils IA. Une entreprise rentable, en croissance, avec une forte ambition européenne. Une équipe bienveillante et passionnée. Les avantages chez N2JSoft : Prime de vacances, Chèques cadeaux à Noël, Chèques rentrée scolaire (si tu as des enfants), Chèque culture, Cours de musique, Événements d'équipe toute l'année. description: Notre mission ⚖️ Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe. Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence. Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance. Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales. Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction. Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début. Sujet de stage Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage. Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure : Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple) Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat Et d'autres fonctionnalités ! Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides. Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien. Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc. Nos valeurs 🤝 Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses. Challenge the status quo : n ous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur. Liberty and responsibility : n ous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership. Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Sujet de stage

Doctrine développe des workflows dédiés aux professionnels du droit pour accélérer et améliorer la gestion de leurs dossiers. Parmi eux, Jobexit accompagne les avocats et juristes en droit social dans la simulation de ruptures du contrat de travail, notamment en calculant les indemnités de départ, les indemnités en cas de contentieux, le calendrier de sortie et les allocations chômage.

Dans un litige, un salarié peut demander plusieurs choses à la fois : des salaires impayés, une indemnité de licenciement, des dommages et intérêts, etc. L'objectif du stage est de permettre à l'utilisateur de saisir et d'organiser toutes ces demandes dans l'application, pour mieux estimer les montants en jeu, préparer la négociation avec la partie adverse et générer automatiquement le récapitulatif final destiné au juge. Ceci peut inclure :

  • Concevoir une interface pour ajouter, modifier et réordonner les demandes d'un dossier, chacune avec son montant, son unité de calcul et son ordre
  • Modéliser les dépendances entre demandes (une demande qui ne s'applique que si une autre est refusée par exemple)
  • Calculer et afficher les montants (du coût pour l’employeur au net empoché par le salarié), pour aider l'utilisateur à évaluer les risques
  • Générer automatiquement un document de synthèse clair et structuré, prêt à être intégré dans les conclusions écrites de l'avocat
  • Et d'autres fonctionnalités !

Le ou la stagiaire participera à la compréhension du besoin utilisateur autour de ces outils (en collaboration avec les équipes produit et les juristes) et à la définition des solutions techniques (en collaboration avec les équipes techniques). description: Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s. Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française. Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.
